info.title: TurfTap API
info.description: Every reply is wrapped as { status, message, data }. Staff send X-Tenant-Id; the Customer Portal sends X-Tenant-Slug. Errors carry a code (tt_<area>_<nnn>) and a traceId.

code.description: Stable error code, such as tt_ven_001

OpeningHours.description: A weekday that is not listed is closed.
